method: Cross-task current-state reconstruction as a prerequisite to sensor/forecast fusion. Single fixed LightGBM speed imputer, no queue model or thresholds changed.
input: Only13allowedframes. Mask ALL ownTspeed-derivedchannels0/4/9/10 in trainandquery; observedneighborTspeed allowed after removing selfedges. Keepflow/occupancy/quality/missingness/static/history; nofuturedata.
targets: JuneNov unmaskedtrueTspeed only as supervisedstate target, reliable eligiblecurrenttruth; neverinput. Uniform64knownnodes/window, independentofspeed/queue label.
evaluation: December actualunobserved/lowqualityTspeed cells, compare causal latestreliablepreTspeed. Report roadmacroRMSE normalizedbyfreespeed and kmh. Reconstruction gain alone is not queue improvement.
